message.content:
A vertical magazine cover features a black-and-white photograph of a man in a police uniform from the waist up. The man, in profile facing left, wears a peaked cap and a short-sleeved uniform shirt with multiple shoulder boards, medals, and a circular patch on his left sleeve. He is touching the brim of his cap with his right hand, which also has a watch on the wrist. His expression is neutral.

At the top, the large red word "TEMPO" is printed in a bold serif font. Above it, smaller black text reads "TETEN MASDUKI SI KUDA HITAM" on the left and "INVESTIGASI: IZIN JANGGAL PABRIK SEMEN" on the right, separated by a thin diagonal line. A blurry sign behind "TEMPO" contains the word "KELUAR." 

Below the magazine title, the date "7-13 SEPTEMBER 2015" appears in small black font. Centered above the man, the words "WASESO, WASALAM..." are printed in large, black, sans-serif, bold capital letters. A barcode and price information, "RP 39.500," are positioned vertically along the bottom right edge. A thick red border runs along the left side and across the bottom of the cover.
